# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 08 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market: Prices Ease for Second Quarter Running

- **Private home price growth at seven-quarter low; HDB resale prices fall again in Q2 2026** - URA and HDB flash estimates show private home prices edged up in Q2 2026 at their weakest pace in seven quarters, while HDB resale prices declined for a second consecutive quarter. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ura-hdb-flash-estimates-q2-2026-breakdown/)

- **HDB resale prices down 0.3% in Q2 2026, with 16 towns recording price drops** - The second consecutive quarterly decline coincides with younger resale flat transactions hitting a six-year low; 10 towns still posted gains, led by the Central Area. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fall-again-2q2026/)

- **Million-dollar HDB flat sales hit a new high even as overall resale prices hold flat in June** - Month-on-month and year-on-year resale prices were unchanged in June 2026, while sales activity softened slightly and the number of million-dollar flat transactions reached a new record. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-stay-stable-in-june-2026-as-million-dollar-flat-sales-hit-new-high/)

- **Serangoon Executive flat sets new town resale record at $1,270,000** - A unit at 232A Serangoon Avenue 2 sold in July 2026 for $1,270,000, beating the previous Serangoon record by $2,000, with the town's 12-month median resale price sitting at $1,050,000. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/serangoon-executive-flat-resale-record/)

## New Supply & Development Pipeline

- **URA launches tender for Town Hall Link White Site in Jurong Lake District, with up to 1,200 homes possible** - The 3.72ha site is on the Confirmed List of the 2H 2026 GLS Programme and is expected to anchor the next phase of Jurong Lake District's development, with bids anticipated to start from $1.8 billion. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/jld-town-hall-link-gls-white-site/)

## Legal & Ownership

- **$5.5 million Siglap home purchase caught in inheritance dispute after seller's widow contested his will** - The case highlights how OTPs, caveats, and Singapore's property legal framework interact when a property sale is challenged by a third-party inheritance claim. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/siglap-landed-home-inheritance-dispute-singapore/)
